{"path":"test_scope.py","content":"import pytest
from scope import path_matches


def test_exact_path_glob_matches():
    """Test that an exact-path glob matches"""
    assert path_matches("file.txt", ["file.txt"]) == True
    assert path_matches("dir/file.txt", ["dir/file.txt"]) == True


def test_double_star_glob_matches_deeply_nested():
    """Test that a ** glob matches a deeply nested path under it"""
    assert path_matches("a/b/c/d/e/file.txt", ["**/file.txt"]) == True
    assert path_matches("deep/nested/path/to/file.txt", ["**/file.txt"]) == True
    assert path_matches("file.txt", ["**/file.txt"]) == True


def test_single_star_glob_does_not_match_extra_directory_level():
    """Test that a single-* glob does NOT match a path with an extra directory level in the starred segment"""
    assert path_matches("a/b/file.txt", ["a/*/file.txt"]) == True
    assert path_matches("a/b/c/file.txt", ["a/*/file.txt"]) == False
    assert path_matches("dir/subdir/file.txt", ["dir/*/file.txt"]) == False


def test_path_outside_every_glob_does_not_match():
    """Test that a path outside every glob does not match"""
    assert path_matches("file.txt", ["other.txt"]) == False
    assert path_matches("dir/file.txt", ["other/dir/file.txt"]) == False
    assert path_matches("a/b/c/file.txt", ["a/b/file.txt"]) == False


def test_empty_glob_list_never_matches():
    """Test that an empty glob list never matches"""
    assert path_matches("file.txt", []) == False
    assert path_matches("dir/file.txt", []) == False
    assert path_matches("", []) == False"}
